_comment: Test and demo prompts of the en locale. Test ids, personas, surfaces and phases are in ../../pack.json (tests). {upn:<personaKey>} and {upn:instance} are replaced with real addresses when the handout is generated.

notes.trafficReplay: The prompts of the web-UI agents can be replayed for traffic by the Prompts Sender agent.
notes.s2sIdentity: Never ask an S2S agent about its own identity: it misreports it.
notes.fdTransient: The Foundry agent may once fail with a transient HTTP 400 (invented tool argument): retry; avoid that prompt live.
notes.securityPrompts: The security test texts of D12, D16 and D17 are operator slots (see OPERATOR-SLOTS.md).

B1.prompt: Hi, answer with a single sentence to confirm that you are online.

B2.prompt: Can you read the content of https://example.com/ or at least tell me whether it is reachable (HTTP 200)?

prompts: What is the capital of France?
How many arrondissements does it have?
Which one is the most populous?

RA-02.prompt: List the last 2 e-mails I received: for each one only date, subject and sender.

RA-03.prompt: Send an e-mail to {upn:maker} with subject “Test A365 lab” and text “Hello from Records Assistant”, then confirm the sending.

RA-05.prompt: What is the status of record REC-2026-000123?
RA-05.expected: about one answer in two is a simulated error: these errors feed “Agents with exceptions” (D1) and the map (D2)

RA-06.prompt: Register with the records office the request of Epsilon Textiles about the forms update and give me the number.
RA-06.expected: a record number: the agent now has a second active user

RA-07.expected: not executed while the server is blocked; note how long the block and the unblock take to apply

RA-08.expected: the tool invocation is blocked by the real-time protection rule

prompts: Check the status of the record you have just registered.
RA-09.expected: a record number, then the status or a simulated error: feeds the map line (D2) and the exceptions (D1)

RC-01.expected: a greeting with the instance name

prompts: Who are you and what can you do?
List by name the tools you have.
RC-02.expected: the instance name and the tools

RC-03.prompt: Send an e-mail to {upn:maker} with subject “Test A365 lab” and text “Hello from the records colleague”, then confirm the sending.
RC-03.expected: e-mail sent from the mailbox of the instance ({upn:instance})

RC-04.expected: it asks for sender and subject

RC-05.prompt: Register this request: sender Alpha Engineering Ltd (alphaengineering@registered.example), subject “Request for an extension of the deadline for uploading quotes”, 2 attachments.

RC-06.prompt: Forward the registered request and its attachments to reviewer@external.example.
RC-06.expected: refused: no forwarding outside the organization

RC-07.prompt: E-mail to {upn:instance} – subject “Registration request – Beta Construction”, body “Good morning, please register the request for additional documents of Beta Construction DAC for application APP-2026-0002. I attach 1 document. Thank you, Anna Walsh” and a small attachment.
RC-07.expected: an e-mail reply with record number and date

RC-08.prompt: List the last 2 e-mails you received in your mailbox: for each one only date, subject and sender.
RC-08.expected: the e-mail of RC-07 is listed

RM-02.prompt: Run the reports check of the last 24 hours.
RM-02.expected: 8 reports in 4 groups; top 3 REP-004 (IBAN change), REP-001, REP-002; “officer not available” (not authorized to read the directory)

RM-03.expected: the officers are listed per office (Dublin / Cork)

RM-04.prompt: Run the reports check of the last 24 hours.
RM-04.expected: “officer not available” with the reason “access blocked by Conditional Access”

AR-02.prompt: List the last 2 e-mails I received: for each one only date, subject and sender.

AR-03.prompt: Analyze application APP-2026-0002 of Beta Construction DAC and tell me what is missing.
AR-03.expected: Form C, Tax Clearance Certificate and project schedule missing; quote Q-02 not signed; Form B version 2.0 without registered e-mail; text of the request for additional documents; no eligibility decision

AR-04.prompt: According to the review procedure, which checks are made on the quotes?
AR-04.expected: in the name of the business, VAT shown separately, not older than 6 months, signed, sum of the net amounts equal to the cost in Form A

AR-05.prompt: Search Microsoft Learn for how to assign a sponsor to an agent identity in Microsoft Entra.

AR-06.prompt: Analyze application APP-2026-0002 of Beta Construction DAC and tell me what is missing.
AR-06.expected: the same answer as AR-03, now in Microsoft 365 Copilot

GD-01.prompt: A business asks whether a project to reduce the noise in its workshop is eligible for the grant: what do we answer?
GD-01.expected: a draft answer grounded in the Summary / FAQ, citing document and section

GD-02.prompt: Prepare a Word reminder for Alpha Engineering Ltd about the deadline for uploading quotes.
GD-02.expected: a Word document; 30/11/2026 18:00 “unless extended by circular” (the extension is in the Circulars, not in this agent's knowledge)

GD-03.expected: it explains that registrations are made with the records assistant (new-harness agents accept no BYO MCP server)

GP-01.prompt: A business asks whether a project to reduce the noise in its workshop is eligible for the grant: what do we answer?

GP-02.prompt: Open the agent the morning of the demo.

SI-01.prompt: I have to inspect the funded project of Gamma Farms at the Galway site: prepare dates, checklist and communication.
SI-01.expected: three date windows, the checklist and the draft communication from the Inspections document

CA-01.expected: the message is blocked (only after the threat detection is on)

CA-02.prompt: Prepare a communication for the businesses about the new version 2.1 of Form A.
CA-02.expected: a draft from the Notices knowledge; it asks before sending

prompts: What is the minimum eligible cost?
By when must the applications be submitted?

CI-01.prompt: By when can the supplementary quotes be uploaded?
CI-01.expected: 15/12/2026 18:00 (Circular 2/2026 overrides the 30/11 of Circular 1/2026, and it says so)

FO-01.prompt: Which form must I use for the de minimis declaration and which fields are mandatory?
FO-01.expected: Form C and its mandatory fields

PC-01.prompt: Who is the contact person at Alpha Engineering and how do I reach them?
PC-01.expected: an answer from the personal Excel file

CC-01.expected: Communication Compliance matches after about 1 hour

DL-01.prompt: Prepare the summary sheet of application {{org.caseIdPrefix}}0004.
DL-01.expected: the agent says that the document is not available because of the organization's policies and does not reconstruct it

DL-02.prompt: Prepare the summary sheet of application {{org.caseIdPrefix}}0002.
DL-02.expected: the summary sheet with all its sections and the source document
